Contains 6 rows (3 categories × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `category` (Communicable, NCD, Injury), `dalys_millions` (float). Represents aggregate global DALYs by broad disease category.

## Data Notes
- DALY estimates are modeled based on GBD-style methodology; 2024 figures are projected estimates.
- Communicable category includes maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions per GBD convention.
- Percentages may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.

    (2, "Diarrheal diseases", 155.2, "Communicable"),
    (3, "Neonatal preterm birth", 103.8, "Communicable"),

    (8, "Measles", 65.9, "Communicable"),

    (10, "Road injuries", 52.7, "Injury"),
]
causes_2024 = [
    (1, "Ischemic heart disease", 192.3, "NCD"),
    (2, "Stroke", 147.8, "NCD"),
    (3, "Diabetes mellitus", 118.4, "NCD"),
    (4, "COPD", 105.1, "NCD"),
    (5, "Neonatal preterm birth", 82.6, "Communicable"),
    (6, "Lower respiratory infections", 78.3, "Communicable"),
    (7, "Low back pain", 74.9, "NCD"),
    (8, "Depressive disorders", 68.5, "NCD"),
    (9, "Road injuries", 63.2, "Injury"),
    (10, "Lung cancer", 58.7, "NCD"),
]

        ("Low\nincome", 71.2, 19.8, 9.0),
        ("Lower-middle\nincome", 52.4, 36.1, 11.5),
        ("Upper-middle\nincome", 28.7, 57.3, 14.0),
        ("High\nincome", 8.3, 81.6, 10.1),
    ],
    2024: [
        ("Low\nincome", 52.8, 37.4, 9.8),
        ("Lower-middle\nincome", 27.1, 60.5, 12.4),
        ("Upper-middle\nincome", 11.3, 77.2, 11.5),
        ("High\nincome", 4.1, 87.8, 8.1),
    ],
}

    1990: {"Communicable": 1128.4, "NCD": 768.2, "Injury": 253.7},
    2024: {"Communicable": 612.5, "NCD": 1487.3, "Injury": 308.6},
}

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, width_ratios=[1.1, 1], height_ratios=[1.15, 1],
                       hspace=0.32, wspace=0.28,
                       left=0.06, right=0.96, top=0.88, bottom=0.06)

fig.suptitle('The Global Epidemiological Transition: Disease Burden Shift, 1990 → 2024',
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR, y=0.96,
             fontfamily='serif')
fig.text(0.5, 0.925,
         'Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) by cause, category, and World Bank income group',
         ha='center', fontsize=12, color='#666666', fontfamily='serif')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A: Slope chart — Top 10 causes rank change
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_slope = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_slope.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
ax_slope.set_title('Top 10 DALY Causes: Rank Change', fontsize=TITLE_SIZE,
                    fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR, loc='left', pad=12, fontfamily='serif')
ax_slope.text(-0.02, 1.04, 'A', transform=ax_slope.transAxes,
              fontsize=PANEL_LABEL_SIZE, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR, fontfamily='serif')

# Build lookup
name_to_1990 = {c[1]: c for c in causes_1990}
name_to_2024 = {c[1]: c for c in causes_2024}
all_causes = set(c[1] for c in causes_1990) | set(c[1] for c in causes_2024)

# Positions
x_left, x_right = 0.0, 1.0
rank_positions = {i: 11 - i for i in range(1, 15)}  # invert so rank 1 is at top

# Draw connections
for cause in all_causes:
    r1990 = name_to_1990.get(cause)
    r2024 = name_to_2024.get(cause)
    if r1990 and r2024:
        cat = r1990[3]
        y1 = rank_positions[r1990[0]]
        y2 = rank_positions[r2024[0]]
        shift = abs(r2024[0] - r1990[0])
        lw = 2.0 + shift * 0.6
        alpha = 0.5 + min(shift * 0.07, 0.4)
        ax_slope.plot([x_left, x_right], [y1, y2], color=COLORS[cat],
                      linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=2)
        ax_slope.scatter([x_left], [y1], color=COLORS[cat], s=50, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.5)
        ax_slope.scatter([x_right], [y2], color=COLORS[cat], s=50, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.5)

# Causes that dropped off / entered
for cause in all_causes:
    r1990 = name_to_1990.get(cause)
    r2024 = name_to_2024.get(cause)
    if r1990 and not r2024:
        cat = r1990[3]
        y1 = rank_positions[r1990[0]]
        ax_slope.scatter([x_left], [y1], color=COLORS[cat], s=50, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.5)
        ax_slope.plot([x_left, x_right], [y1, 0.2], color=COLORS[cat],
                      linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.25, linestyle='--', solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)
    if r2024 and not r1990:
        cat = r2024[3]
        y2 = rank_positions[r2024[0]]
        ax_slope.scatter([x_right], [y2], color=COLORS[cat], s=50, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.5)
        ax_slope.plot([x_left, x_right], [0.2, y2], color=COLORS[cat],
                      linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.25, linestyle='--', solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

# Labels on left (1990)

    y = rank_positions[rank]
    ax_slope.text(x_left - 0.03, y, f'{rank}. {cause}  ({dalys:.0f}M)',
                  ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8.2, color=COLORS[cat],
                  fontweight='bold' if rank <= 3 else 'normal', fontfamily='serif')

# Labels on right (2024)
for rank, cause, dalys, cat in causes_2024:
    y = rank_positions[rank]
    ax_slope.text(x_right + 0.03, y, f'({dalys:.0f}M)  {cause} .{rank}',
                  ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.2, color=COLORS[cat],
                  fontweight='bold' if rank <= 3 else 'normal', fontfamily='serif')

ax_slope.text(x_left, 10.7, '1990', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11,
              fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR, fontfamily='serif')
ax_slope.text(x_right, 10.7, '2024', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11,
              fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR, fontfamily='serif')

ax_slope.set_xlim(-0.65, 1.65)
ax_slope.set_ylim(-0.3, 11.2)
ax_slope.axis('off')

# Add "dropped out" / "new entry" annotations
ax_slope.text(0.5, -0.15, 'Dashed lines: causes entering / exiting the top 10',
              ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888',
              fontstyle='italic', fontfamily='serif', transform=ax_slope.transData)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B: Global category totals (paired bars)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax_global = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_global.set_facecolor(BG_COLOR)
ax_global.set_title('Global DALYs by Category', fontsize=TITLE_SIZE,
                     fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR, loc='left', pad=12, fontfamily='serif')
ax_global.text(-0.02, 1.04, 'B', transform=ax_global.transAxes,
               fontsize=PANEL_LABEL_SIZE, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT_COLOR, fontfamily='serif')

categories = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']
x_cat = np.arange(len(categories))
bar_w = 0.32

vals_1990 = [global_totals[1990][c] for c in categories]
vals_2024 = [global_totals[2024][c] for c in categories]

bars1 = ax_global.bar(x_cat - bar_w/2, vals_1990, bar_w, label='1990',
                       color=[COLORS[c] for c in categories], alpha=0.55,
                       edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
bars2 = ax_global.bar(x_cat + bar_w/2, vals_2024, bar_w, label='2024',

for bar, val in zip(bars1, vals_1990):

    pct = (change / vals_1990[i]) * 100
    sign = '+' if change > 0 else ''
    arrow = '▲' if change > 0 else '▼'
